components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Seal gold stamp for the main action.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--accent, #e8a317); color: var(--ink, #0f1c2e); font: 500 0.875rem/1.4 "Source Sans 3", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1), transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--accent-hover, #d49210); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring, #8a5a00); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Docket navy fill for a second action.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--ink, #0f1c2e); color: var(--paper, #f3f5f8); font: 500 0.875rem/1.4 "Source Sans 3", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1), transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: rgb(15 28 46 / 0.90); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring, #8a5a00); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--border, #c9d1dc); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--surface, #ffffff); color: var(--ink, #0f1c2e); font: 500 0.875rem/1.4 "Source Sans 3", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: rgb(15 28 46 / 0.04); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring, #8a5a00); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-outline:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

components.name: Danger Button
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--danger, #9f1239); color: #fff; font: 500 0.875rem/1.4 "Source Sans 3", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background: rgb(159 18 57 / 0.90); } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring, #8a5a00); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-danger:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

components.name: Text Field
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; } .ds-field-label { font: 500 0.875rem/1.4 "Source Sans 3", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--ink, #0f1c2e); } .ds-input { min-height: 44px; width: 100%; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--border, #c9d1dc); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--surface, #ffffff); color: var(--ink, #0f1c2e); font: 400 1rem/1.5 "Source Sans 3", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(15 28 46 / 0.05); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--ink-subtle, #4a5d73); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring, #8a5a00); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-input[aria-invalid="true"] { border-color: var(--danger, #9f1239); }

components.name: Surface
components.description: Elevated paperwork for lists, forms, and queues.
components.css: .ds-surface { border: 1px solid var(--border, #c9d1dc); border-radius: 12px; background: var(--surface, #ffffff); padding: 16px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(15 28 46 / 0.04), 0 8px 24px rgb(15 28 46 / 0.06); color: var(--ink, #0f1c2e); font: 400 1rem/1.6 "Source Sans 3", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-surface-title { margin: 0; font-weight: 500; } .ds-surface-meta { margin: 4px 0 0; font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--ink-muted, #3d4f63); }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: Processing status with a text label.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; border-radius: 6px; padding: 2px 8px; font: 500 0.75rem/1.4 "Source Sans 3", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.04em; } .ds-chip-accent { background: rgb(232 163 23 / 0.25); color: var(--accent-ink, #7a4e00); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring, #8a5a00); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Portal Nav Item
components.html: DocumentsUpload
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; padding: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--border, #c9d1dc); border-radius: 12px; background: var(--surface, #ffffff); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(15 28 46 / 0.04), 0 8px 24px rgb(15 28 46 / 0.06); } .ds-nav-item { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 6px; color: var(--ink-muted, #3d4f63); font: 500 0.875rem/1.4 "Source Sans 3", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: rgb(15 28 46 / 0.04); color: var(--ink, #0f1c2e); } .ds-nav-item-active { background: var(--ink, #0f1c2e); color: var(--paper, #f3f5f8); } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring, #8a5a00); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
The interface is a stamped case file, not a dashboard skin and not a dark-tech console. Cool bond paper is the field; docket navy is the ink; seal gold is the stamp you press when the work is ready. Density is operational: lists, fields, and queues scan first. Display type (Fraunces) is the heading on the form, not a marketing poster.

Personality is restrained and accountable. Gold is rare. Surfaces stay quiet paperwork. Press feedback is tactile (scale 0.97) without theatrical motion. Confirmed rejections: decorative AI purple glow, emoji-driven UI, color-only status, dark-tech skins, and two-axis grid overlays on operate screens.
keyCharacteristics: Light paper canvas with white elevated surfaces
Navy ink for text and selected navigation
Seal gold reserved for primary action
Fraunces for titles, Source Sans 3 for body and UI
Hybrid depth: flat page, bordered card with a soft offset shadow

rules.name: The Rare Seal Rule
rules.body: Seal gold is the primary action, not atmosphere. Do not flood screens with gold fills, gold text, or gold borders.

rules.name: The Contrast-Not-Opacity Rule
rules.body: Muted text uses ink-muted or ink-subtle. Do not fade ink with alpha for body or labels.

rules.name: The Form-Heading Rule
rules.body: Fraunces is for titles. Do not set body, tables, or chips in the display face.

rules.name: The Tracking Floor Rule
rules.body: Display tracking is −0.03em. Do not go tighter than −0.04em.

rules.name: The Flat-Page Rule
rules.body: The canvas stays flat. Shadow appears on elevated paperwork, not on the viewport background.

rules.name: The One Elevation Rule
rules.body: Border or shadow may suffice; the incumbent Surface uses both once. Do not stack a second large halo.

dos: Do put primary actions on Seal Gold with Docket Navy type.
Do keep interactive targets at least 44px tall.
Do pair every status color with a text label.
Do wrap or clamp long filenames; never let them blow the layout.
Do use ink-muted for supporting copy instead of transparent navy.
donts: Don't use decorative AI purple glow, neon gradients, or dark-tech chrome.
Don't drive UI with emoji or Unicode as an icon system.
Don't communicate status by color alone.
Don't put two-axis grid overlays on operate (portal) screens.
Don't spend Seal Gold on large backgrounds or body text.
Don't set body copy in Fraunces.
Don't invent RAG, vector, or multi-agent chrome that the product does not have.
